title: fix(platform-objects)!: a business unit with child units refuses its delete instead of silently re-rooting them
body:
Fixes #24939

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Dispatched by the `domain:engine` seat 1 (claim 6300791873); built by dev session `session_01VBFXArkqADbAp54xq6RAZE`. The narrowing face owes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue.

## What changes

- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-business-unit.object.ts`: `parent_business_unit_id` declares `deleteBehavior: 'restrict'`. Nothing else in the object moves.
- Its help text becomes true: "Self-reference for the org tree. Null = root of tenant. A unit that still has child units cannot be deleted until they are re-parented or deleted." A comment beside the field says why `restrict` and not the default `set_null`.
- The `en` bundle is regenerated (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`); the hand-written `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES` help strings are translated to match (values only, no key moves).
- Changeset: `minor` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`, **BREAKING** with FROM / TO / Fix, the `Clause-②` line and the `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker (`check-adr-0087-registration` green).

## Before / after, measured on the wire

Fresh showcase backend (`pnpm dev -- --fresh`) at this branch's head, as the seeded admin, the card's steps. The before column is the card's own measurement on 18.0.0 and, on `main` `f32d795ce5`, a real-engine probe with the shipped object (delete answered `true`, the child's parent became `null`):

| request | before (main, `set_null`) | after (this PR) |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_business_unit/bu_qa_emea` (has 1 child) | `200`; the child's parent becomes `null` (card's measurement, and re-measured on a real engine below) | `409`, `code: DELETE_RESTRICTED`, `dependentObject: sys_business_unit`, `dependentCount: 1`, `error`: "This Business Unit is still referenced by 1 Business Unit record(s) through “Parent Business Unit”. Delete or reassign them first." The child keeps `parent_business_unit_id = bu_qa_emea`. |
| `DELETE …/bu_field_ops` (seeded, 2 children) | `200`, both children re-rooted (inferred from the engine probe, not re-measured on the wire) | `409 DELETE_RESTRICTED`, `dependentCount: 2` |
| `POST …/deleteMany` `{"ids":["bu_qa_emea","bu_qa_office"]}` (root first) | `200`, both deleted (inferred, not re-measured) | `200` with `success: false`: row 0 `DELETE_RESTRICTED` (409), row 1 `NOT_ATTEMPTED` (the batch stops, as `deleteMany` always does without `continueOnError`); nothing deleted |
| `POST …/deleteMany` `{"ids":["bu_qa_office","bu_qa_emea"],"options":{"atomic":true}}` (leaf to root) | `200` (inferred) | `200`, `succeeded: 2` |
| `DELETE …/bu_west_coast` (leaf) | `200` (inferred) | `200` |

The refusal names the blocking object and the child count, so the administrator knows to re-parent first. How the console displays it is objectui's (read only, not changed here).

## Every deleter of `sys_business_unit`, read before the edit

- **Data API by id** (`DELETE /data/:object/:id`) → `engine.delete` by id → `cascadeDeleteRelations` → refused while children exist.
- **Bulk** (`POST /data/:object/deleteMany`, `batchData`'s delete case): a per-id loop in the caller's order (`runDeleteManyLoop`), `atomic` = one transaction. Leaf to root completes; root first refuses the root (measured above). A `multi: true` engine delete addressed by id was also refused on a real engine.
- **One cascade:** nothing cascades into `sys_business_unit` (its `organization_id` is a plain lookup, `set_null`), so no cascade set ever holds units. Were one to, the engine's #22305 rule already judges `restrict` only against rows outside the cascade set.
- **An organization's delete:** `organization_id` is `set_null`, so the units stay and keep their tree (pinned below). No organization teardown deletes units. The v18 ownership ceremony (`os migrate organization-ownership`) gives `sys_business_unit` fate `attribution`, never a delete.
- **Sample-data purge** (`cloud-connection` `marketplace-install-local-purge.ts`): deletes through the engine in the REVERSE of the loader's insert order. The showcase seed lists the tree parent first, so the purge deletes leaf to root and completes. See open note 2.
- **Seeds / resets / `os` commands / plugin-sharing:** the seed loader never deletes; no `os` command deletes units; plugin-sharing binds `afterDelete` recomputes only, which a refused delete never reaches.
- **Tests and fixtures:** the objectql suites that delete a `sys_business_unit` (`engine-delete-restricted-locale`, `engine-cascade-federated-tenant-anchor`) register their own fixture objects; `bu-tree-recompute.test.ts` uses a fake engine. No existing pin moves.

The stop condition was not met: no platform path deletes a parent before its children in a way `restrict` breaks.

## Pins

`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-parent-delete-restrict.test.ts` (new): a REAL engine (ObjectQL + SqlDriver over in-memory SQLite) carrying the SHIPPED `SysBusinessUnit` and `SysOrganization`. It lives in plugin-sharing because `platform-objects` has no engine or driver among its dependencies; plugin-sharing already depends on both and owns the subtree walk the refusal protects. No recompute code is touched.

1. the field declares `restrict`;
2. a unit with children: `code` `DELETE_RESTRICTED`, `status` 409, `dependentObject`, `dependentCount` 1; the tree is unchanged;
3. a leaf deletes;
4. a unit whose child was re-parented deletes, and the child keeps its new parent;
5. bulk leaf to root completes; 6. the same in one transaction (the atomic arm) completes;
7. bulk root first: the root alone is refused, its subtree whole;
8. an organization's delete completes on a tree, the units and their parents intact.

**Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` + `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, platform-objects rebuilt on each leg because plugin-sharing reads its `dist/`): removing `deleteBehavior: 'restrict'` (anchor 1 → 0, dist marker absent from all 66 built files) turns pins 1, 2 and 7 red (3 failed / 5 passed). Restored: blob `c68f61b6c63a` equals `HEAD`, whole-tree `git status` clean, dist marker present again, 8/8 green.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Bulk order is the caller's.** A bulk delete that lists a parent before its child now refuses the parent (and, without `continueOnError`, stops the batch). The console's bulk delete sends ids in the grid's order, which is objectui's; leaf to root completes.
2. **Sample-data purge on a seed authored child before parent.** The purge deletes in reverse record order within one self-referencing dataset; a seed listing a child unit before its parent would have its parent refused (counted in the purge's `errors`, which already names "a restrict" as a cause). Every shipped seed of this object (`examples/app-showcase`) lists parents first.
3. **Docs.** `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` Step 1 says nothing false (it does not describe deleting a unit); a sentence on retiring a unit leaf-first would help. A `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` item for the refusal would be `domain:devx`'s.
